decisions.rationale: "Duchenne and Becker muscular dystrophy" is one contiguous string referring to two separate diseases (Duchenne and Becker muscular dystrophy), so it is annotated as a single Composite Mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §2 (Annotate contiguous text strings; Composite Mention) and Examples §7

decisions.rationale: Second occurrence of the contiguous string "Duchenne and Becker muscular dystrophy" referring to two separate diseases; annotated again as a Composite Mention because duplicate mentions are annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §2 (Composite Mention) and §4 (Annotate duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: "DMD and BMD" is a contiguous string naming two distinct diseases through their abbreviations, so it is a Composite Mention rather than two separate mentions.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §2 (Composite Mention) and §6 (synonymous/abbreviation mentions)

decisions.rationale: "DMD" in "the central part of the DMD gene" names the gene locus, not the disease, so it is not a disease mention and is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (only disease mentions are annotated); gene symbols are not disease references

decisions.rationale: "DMD" in "particularly in DMD" refers to the disease Duchenne muscular dystrophy, a single specific disease with no further categorization.
"DMD" in "Deletions specific to DMD" is a disease name used as an adjunct that modifies the noun phrase "Deletions", so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §3 (Disease mentions used as Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: "BMD" in "specific to DMD and to BMD" is a disease name used as an adjunct modifying "Deletions", so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §3 (Disease mentions used as Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: "BMD" in "all BMD patients" is a disease name modifying the noun "patients", analogous to "colorectal cancer families" in the guideline example, so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §3 (Modifier; example of colorectal cancer families)

decisions.rationale: "the more severe DMD" uses DMD as a noun phrase referring to the disease itself (a severe form of Duchenne muscular dystrophy), so it is a Specific Disease.
